question: What are the ids of customers who spend more than 5 on average for each good?
schema:
tenant=spider_bakery_1
tables:
  - customers
      Id: int
      LastName: str — last name
      FirstName: str — first name
  - goods
      Id: str
      Flavor: str
      Food: str
      Price: float
  - items
      Receipt: int
      Ordinal: int
      Item: str
  - receipts
      ReceiptNumber: int — receipt number
      Date: str
      CustomerId: int — customer id
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - items.Item → goods.Id
  - receipts.CustomerId → customers.Id
gold_sql: SELECT T3.CustomerId FROM goods AS T1 JOIN items AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.item JOIN receipts AS T3 ON T2.receipt = T3.ReceiptNumber GROUP BY T3.CustomerId HAVING AVG(T1.price) > 5
system_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT `customers`.`Id`
FROM `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`receipts`
JOIN `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`customers` ON `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`receipts`.`CustomerId` = `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`customers`.`Id`
JOIN `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`items` ON `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`receipts`.`ReceiptNumber` = `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`items`.`Receipt`
JOIN `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`goods` ON `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`items`.`Item` = `workspace`.`bakery_1`.`goods`.`Id`
WHERE `goods`.`Price` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `customers`.`Id`, `goods`.`Id`
HAVING AVG(`goods`.`Price`) > 5

question: Find all receipts which either has the earliest date or has a good with price above 10.
schema:
tenant=spider_bakery_1
tables:
  - customers
      Id: int
      LastName: str — last name
      FirstName: str — first name
  - goods
      Id: str
      Flavor: str
      Food: str
      Price: float
  - items
      Receipt: int
      Ordinal: int
      Item: str
  - receipts
      ReceiptNumber: int — receipt number
      Date: str
      CustomerId: int — customer id
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - items.Item → goods.Id
  - receipts.CustomerId → customers.Id
gold_sql: SELECT T1.Receipt FROM items AS T1 JOIN goods AS T2 ON T1.item = T2.id WHERE T2.price > 10 UNION SELECT ReceiptNumber FROM receipts WHERE date = (SELECT date FROM receipts ORDER BY date LIMIT 1)
system_sql: WITH valid_dates AS (SELECT ReceiptNumber, try_to_date(Date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') AS parsed_date FROM workspace.bakery_1.receipts), earliest_date AS (SELECT MIN(parsed_date) AS min_date FROM valid_dates WHERE parsed_date IS NOT NULL), receipts_with_earliest_date AS (SELECT ReceiptNumber FROM valid_dates, earliest_date WHERE parsed_date = min_date), receipts_with_price_above_10 AS (SELECT DISTINCT receipts.ReceiptNumber FROM workspace.bakery_1.items JOIN workspace.bakery_1.goods ON items.Item = goods.Id JOIN workspace.bakery_1.receipts ON items.Receipt = receipts.ReceiptNumber WHERE goods.Price > 10) SELECT DISTINCT receipts.ReceiptNumber, receipts.Date, receipts.CustomerId FROM workspace.bakery_1.receipts WHERE receipts.ReceiptNumber IN (SELECT ReceiptNumber FROM receipts_with_earliest_date UNION SELECT ReceiptNumber FROM receipts_with_price_above_10)
